extraction.Name: Rush Roberts
extraction.Recorded patent: yes, filed for record in Pawnee County, Oklahoma, when Feb. 2, 1918, by allottee
extraction.Sold/Mortgaged: No mortgage and no sale. Allottee still owns land.
extraction.Occupation/Income: Farm rents from this land. Also receives $50.00 as Indian Scout, from the Government.
extraction.NOTES: Patent delivered 12-26-1917 by mail; receipted yes. Two children: Rush Roberts, Jr. and Terry Roberts, both of Pawnee, Oklahoma, dependent upon the Indian for support. Allottee is very sickly, not very good at this time. No land sold for debt or taxes. Notarized November 26, 1928, in Pawnee County, Oklahoma; commission expires Jan. 31, 1929.
